TEAM / KEVIN DAVISON

KEVIN DAVISON

Hockey Scout

Kevin Davison brings a lifelong passion for hockey and a strong understanding of the game to his role as a Hockey Scout with CADIG Scouting Services.

Having grown up playing minor hockey and later gaining experience as a coach, Kevin understands the game from both the player’s and coach’s perspectives.

Kevin looks beyond statistics and focuses on the complete player — skating, skill, hockey sense, compete level, decision-making, work ethic, coachability and overall potential.
